text:
Alex Kim: Heads-up — PR #3245 (v3 migration guide + SDK snippet) is ready for final review. Need merge timing since this touches the feature-flagged API change (ff/docs_v3_ui).
Marco Ruiz: Can you drop the docs preview link? I want to sanity-check the code example rendering.
Alex Kim: Preview: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/preview/3245 — specifically check docs/v3.0/migration-guide.md and the python/ts SDK snippets.
ci-bot: docs-preview build started for PR 3245 — logs at https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/3245
docs-bot: auto-check: linkcheck found 1 broken internal link in migration-guide.md -> /internal/old-path (report attached).
Jen O'Neill: @Alex the linkcheck failure needs a fix before I can approve. Is that a simple path rename?
Alex Kim: Yeah my bad — missed an anchor rename. Pushing a one-line fix now.
Alex Kim: ```bash
git checkout -b fix/docs-3245-link && sed -i 's|/internal/old-path|/guides/setup|' docs/v3.0/migration-guide.md && git commit -am "fix: update link in migration guide" && git push origin fix/docs-3245-link
```
ci-bot: build triggered for branch fix/docs-3245-link (PR 3245) — running doc preview + linkcheck
Priya Patel: Quick Q — does this PR need to be behind the feature flag rollout? Release notes say ff/docs_v3_ui flips on 2026-03-29. If we merge earlier we should gate with the flag.
release-manager: Correct — merges before 2026-03-29 11:00 PT should include a canary toggle. After cutoff, anything merged to main will go to the next minor. We have two merge slots left in the docs queue today.
Marco Ruiz: I'll do a review pass once CI is green. Focus on the SDK snippet naming and the new API path.
Jen O'Neill: LGTM pending CI. I want to rerun the snippet example locally though — could you add the exact command to run the sample?
Alex Kim: Added run instructions in the snippet block in the preview (see the python example with `python -m example.client`).
docs-bot: linkcheck OK. docs-preview succeeded. Diff: +12 -3 — preview URL https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/preview/3245 (same link)
ci-bot: all checks passed for PR 3245 — ready for merge.
Marco Ruiz: Reviewed and approved. :+1:
Jen O'Neill: Approved. :eyes:
Priya Patel: Confirming we will gate the runtime change with ff/docs_v3_ui. Release-manager — can you allocate the second-to-last merge slot?
release-manager: Slot reserved for 17:20 PT today in the doc merge queue. We'll apply the canary tag on merge and coordinate with infra to ensure routing respects the flag.
Alex Kim: Merging now and adding canary toggle comment in the PR. Thanks everyone.
docs-bot: merged PR 3245 into main with comment "canary: ff/docs_v3_ui=on-internal-only" — docs site will publish versioned v3.0 under /v3.0/migration-guide/
Priya Patel: Thanks — I'll update the rollout checklist to mark this as merged and schedule the flag flip for 2026-03-29.
Marco Ruiz: Nice, thanks Alex.
Jen O'Neill: Great, closing the loop on this one.
